tickets.subject: Bulldog tee (Tauhid Zaman)
tickets.short_outcome: Size S tee out of stock; Bulldog Print Co blocked by overdue invoice #501. Agents queued the $840.00 payment and a customer draft; Supervisor #1 approved it (invoice paid, tee reprint incoming, expected 2026-09-05) and resolved the ticket.

Boss.report: Ticket 101 is waiting for human approval. One size S tee is short, and Bulldog Print Co cannot ship while overdue invoice #501 remains open. Payment request #1 and customer update draft #1 are saved; no arrival date is promised.

Inventory.report: Ticket 101: CC-TEE-WHITE size S has 0 on hand at Aisle B against 1 requested, short 1, with no incoming stock. Bulldog Print Co is the apparel specialty vendor and has a 5-day lead time, but shipment is blocked by open invoice #501 for $840.00, due August 28 and 3 days overdue as of August 31. No arrival date applies unless the blocker is cleared.

Accounting.report: Invoice #501 to Bulldog Print Co is open and 3 days overdue (due August 28); it has not been paid. Queued payment request #1 for $840.00, leaving $2,560.00 after pending requests, which covers the $2,400.00 rent due September 2. The vendor remains blocked pending approval and payment.

Customer Service.report: Classic Bulldog Tee, size S, has 0 on hand and no incoming stock. Saved customer update draft #1 explaining restock depends on invoice approval/payment and no arrival date is confirmed.

tickets.subject: Rent due (Elm City Properties)
tickets.short_outcome: Lease #1 rent of $2,400.00 due 2026-09-02 confirmed by Facilities and queued by Accounting; landlord draft saved. Supervisor #1 approved it (next due moved to 2026-10-02) and resolved the ticket.

Boss.report: Lease #1 confirms $2,400.00 rent due September 2, 2026, not overdue. Payment request #2 is pending approval; landlord draft #2 is saved and unsent. Ticket is waiting for human action.

Facilities.report: Lease #1 confirms the Chapel Street shop, landlord Elm City Properties, monthly rent $2,400.00, due September 2, 2026 (2 days; not overdue). Accounting queued payment request #2, pending human approval. Landlord message draft #2 is saved for review and was not sent; it does not claim payment was made.

Accounting.report: Queued $2,400.00 rent for Chapel Street shop to Elm City Properties, due September 2, 2026, as payment request #2. It is pending human approval; no money has moved. $160.00 remains available after the request.

tickets.subject: Bulk hoodie discount (Yale AI Club)
tickets.short_outcome: 8 of 20 hoodies on hand. Boss chose 15% off ($49.30 each, 55.4% margin). PO draft #3 for 12 hoodies is $264.00 but only $160.00 is left ($104.00 short), so no payment was requested. Customer draft saved. The human chose to leave the ticket blocked.

Boss.report: Ticket 103 is blocked on funding for the 12-unit restock shortfall. Chose 15% off at $49.30 each ($27.30 margin per unit, 55.4%); 8 units are in stock. PO draft #3 is $264.00 versus $160.00 available cash, leaving a $104.00 gap. Customer reply draft #4 is unsent and makes no restock-date promise.

Inventory.report: Ticket 103: 8 CC-HOOD-NAVY, size M, are on hand in Aisle A against 20 requested, leaving 12 short and no incoming stock. Based on apparel specialty, Bulldog Print Co (vendor #1) is the supplier; it has no open invoices and will ship. Its 5-day lead time gives an earliest arrival of September 5 if an order is approved today. Ticket note added; 8 can be partially filled from stock as an option.

Accounting.report: Ticket 103: all tested discounts are above cost. Draft #3 for 12 hoodies is $264.00; Bulldog Print Co can ship with no blocking invoice, arriving September 5, but cash available is $160.00, leaving a $104.00 shortfall. No payment was requested.

Customer Service.report: Saved customer reply draft #4 for Yale AI Club: 8 navy hoodies, size M, available from stock; remaining 12 depend on funding and a purchase order. Includes the approved 15% price of $49.30 each and does not promise a restock date. Ticket note added; draft was not sent.
